name: SAP SE

news.headline: SAP weighs cutting at least 10,000 jobs in its AI reshuffle
news.summary: Bloomberg reports every department was asked to identify cuts — at least 9% of 113,000 staff, weighted to product development and sales — which is the cost lever behind the margin story, but the number is unconfirmed and still has to survive the unions.

news.headline: SAP confirms suspicious activity, no customer data access found
news.summary: SAP said it detected suspicious activity involving its GitHub developer platform and found no evidence to date of unauthorised access to customer business data — contained so far, and reported alongside the job-cut story rather than on its own.

label: SAPSE
flags: The 10,000 figure is a press report SAP will not confirm — "we do not comment on speculation"; JPMorgan's estimate of ~€750m of extra operating profit from 2028 is an analyst's model of a rumour.
